'''Rff Huff''' was an [[Ariwook]] present at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" /> in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> at some point before [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]'' is set by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] take place, which corresponds to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> While visiting the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], Huff engaged in a [[Lightfight|shootout]] with the [[Ganimed]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Purong]]. Huff had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and carried a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] in a [[Holster/Legends|holster]].<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rff Huff appeared in ''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]'', which was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]], illustrated by [[Ralph McQuarrie]], and published in [[1995]].<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" />
